toegepas.voor: Wat die dag vier, het egter van een koning na al die land se kulture gegroei.
toegepas.na: Wat op dié dag gevier word, het egter van een koning na al die land se kulture uitgebrei.
toegepas.rede_vinder: A day does not celebrate anything (people celebrate on it), and 'gegroei van ... na' calques English 'grew from ... to'; 'uitgebrei' is the natural Afrikaans verb for widening scope.
toegepas.fout: 'Wat die dag vier' can be read with 'die dag' as the object (what celebrates the day), so a reader stumbles; 'gegroei van ... na' is loose for a widening of scope.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The passive 'wat op dié dag gevier word' removes the misreading and 'uitgebrei' is the exact verb, with the same people, order and scope (one king to all the country's cultures) and no protected word touched.

laat_vaar.blok: Erfenis wat jy nie kan vashou nie
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Customs and songs are idiomatically 'oorgedra' to the next generation; 'oorgee' reads as handing over an object.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Ouers gee sulke dinge aan hul kinders oor' is plain, acceptable Afrikaans for a Grade 5 reader, and it deliberately echoes the tradisie glossary entry ('aan hul kinders oorgee'), which a language agent may not change, so the swap is lateral and would break that echo.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Traditions are 'oorgedra' from generation to generation; this also matches the proposed wording in the first study block.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'oorgee' is acceptable for handing on customs, the swap rewords a glossary definition, and its stated reason depends on change 2, which was dropped.

na_skrywer.voor: Gedigte wat iemand, soos 'n leier, se dade en eienskappe prys.
na_skrywer.na: Gedigte wat die dade en eienskappe van iemand, soos 'n leier, prys.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: The inserted 'soos 'n leier' splits the possessive 'iemand ... se', which is awkward to read; the 'van' construction keeps the meaning and reads cleanly.
na_skrywer.fout: The inserted 'soos 'n leier' splits the possessive 'iemand ... se', which is clumsy to read.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real and the proposal keeps the meaning, but it rewords a glossary definition beyond a spelling or grammar error, so the writer must make it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Oor baie jare' for a span of time needs 'heen' in idiomatic Afrikaans; without it it echoes English 'over many years'.
na_skrywer.fout: 'oor baie jare' can be read as 'in many years from now' (as in 'oor twee jaar'), so the time span is ambiguous.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: Adding 'heen' fixes a real ambiguity, but the change sits inside the tradisie glossary definition, which only the writer may reword.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.blok: Erfenis wat jy nie kan vashou nie
vlae.teks: Erfenis wat jy nie kan vashou nie
vlae.rede: The block heading says 'vashou' while the decided definition of nie-tasbare erfenis deliberately uses 'aanraak' (chosen over 'vashou' to mirror tasbare erfenis); a learner sees two verbs for one idea. Whether the heading should follow the definition is a writer's choice, so it is flagged, not changed.
